description_en: Pushes a property value by IP-based canary release
description_zh: 按 IP 灰度推送属性值
kebab_example: aliyun sofa gray-push-ms-config-data --attribute-id 1 --data hello_world --hosts 127.0.0.1,127.0.0.2 --instance-id abcdEFGH1234 --operator wang.li --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrayPushMsConfigData

parameters.help_en: The auto-increment ID of the property. You can obtain the ID by calling the query property operation
parameters.help_zh: 属性自增长 ID，可以通过查询属性接口获取 ID
parameters.name: attribute_id

parameters.help_en: The list of machines for canary release push. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 灰度推送的机器列表，多个 IP 之间英文逗号隔开
parameters.name: hosts

parameters.help_en: The environment instance ID. This is a system field
parameters.help_zh: 系统字段：环境实例 ID
parameters.name: instance_id
